# SerenitySpaces Bahamas

> Private 4-villa corporate event venue in Freeport, Grand Bahama Island. A 35-minute direct flight from Fort Lauderdale (FLL) and under 50 minutes from Miami (MIA). Purpose-built for corporate retreats, executive offsites, team-building events, and client entertainment for US-based (especially Florida-based) companies seeking a Caribbean venue.

## Quick Facts

- **Location:** Sea Breeze area, Freeport, Grand Bahama Island, Bahamas
- **Distance from beach:** 1/4 mile (5-minute walk to Coral Beach)
- **Distance from airport:** 25-minute drive from Grand Bahama International Airport (FPO)
- **Capacity:** Up to 14 guests across 4 interconnected villas (Agave, Coconut, Lime, Pina), expandable to ~22 with overflow options
- **Base rate:** $650/night for the entire 4-villa complex, or $150+/night for individual villas
- **Cleaning fee:** $180
- **Minimum stay:** 3 nights
- **Long-stay discounts:** 10% off up to 7 nights, 15% off up to 14 nights, 20% off up to 30 nights, 25% off for 30+ nights
- **Rating:** 4.75 stars
- **Currency:** USD accepted (Bahamian dollar pegged 1:1 to USD)
- **Passport:** Required for US citizens, no visa needed

## Why It Matters for Florida Companies

- **Closer than the Florida Keys:** Direct 35-minute flight from FLL vs. 3-4 hour drive to Key West
- **More direct flights than many Caribbean destinations:** 30+ weekly direct flights from Florida via American Airlines, Bahamasair, and Western Air
- **Departure airports:** Fort Lauderdale (FLL), Miami (MIA), Orlando (MCO), and West Palm Beach (PBI)
- **International retreat experience without a long-haul flight**
- **Private compound:** Book the whole property for guaranteed privacy vs. sharing a hotel conference center
- **Extended-stay ready:** Full kitchens, washer/dryer, dedicated workspaces, and high-speed WiFi make multi-week corporate stays comfortable

## The Four Main Villas

1. **Agave Villa** — Poolside villa with king bed, ensuite rainfall shower, and private patio. Sleeps up to 4.
2. **Coconut Villa** — Two-room villa with queen bed, separate living area, and kitchenette. Sleeps up to 4.
3. **Lime Villa** — The central gathering space with a full chef's kitchen, 6-person dining table, and communal living/sleeping area. Sleeps 3.
4. **Pina Villa** — Open-concept studio with vaulted ceilings, exposed beams, and a baby grand piano. Sleeps 2.

## Additional Capacity On Request

- **Moringa & Papaya Villas** — Two additional private rooms on the north side of the SerenitySpaces property. Pool access available for an upcharge.
- **Partner property nearby in Freeport** — A separate 3-bedroom villa with king master suite, jacuzzi tub, full granite kitchen, and private yard. Available as an overflow option for larger groups or as a backup if SerenitySpaces is booked for your dates.

## Amenities

- Private shared pool (skimmed daily, professionally cleaned twice per month)
- High-speed WiFi throughout property
- Air conditioning in all villas
- Full chef's kitchen in Lime Villa with refrigerator, stove, oven, microwave, coffee maker, and 6-person dining
- Kitchenettes in Agave, Coconut, and Pina
- Dedicated workspaces
- Washer and dryer
- Self check-in with keypad
- Free parking (1 spot plus 3 street spots)
- TV and hot water in all villas
- Tropical gardens and BBQ grill

## Ideal Use Cases

- Executive team retreats (5-14 people)
- Annual company offsites and planning sessions
- Board of directors meetings
- Client entertainment and VIP hosting
- Sales team incentive trips
- Product launch planning weeks
- Engineering team hackathons and strategy sessions
- Wellness retreats and leadership workshops
